# Underground Black Market
The Underground Black Market is less of an organised group and more a location hidden deep within the [color=orange]Outer Cloud[/color].
Ran by the [color=purple]Godfather[/color] and harboring up to five [color=crimson]Fugitives[/color] from the [color=cyan]TSFMC[/color], the Underground Black Market serves to defy and evade the Trans-Solarian Federation, distributing items considered highly illegal by the TSF for profit and to undermine their authority.
## Smuggling
The Underground Black Market is funded by [color=red]telecrystals[/color] used to ship in illegal items from the greater Perseus Arm. The UndergroundVend located in the armory holds these telecrystals and can be used to purchase items.
[color=crimson]Underground Black Market supply crates[/color] containing deactivated telecrystals can be purchased from the Underground Black Market's cargo request console for $20,000 each. However, their purchase alerts the [color=cyan]TSFMC[/color], who will be on the lookout to intercept any smugglers. Deactivated telecrystals will also emit a passive thermal signature, so be wary about carrying too many.
When a crate is sold at its correct destination, the courier will receive $30,000 (meaning they have made $10,000 profit) and the UndergroundVend will receive ten telecrystals that can be spent on black market items. However, the TSFMC will also be alerted of the crates' sale, so get out quick!
## Consequences
The Underground Black Market and its inhabitants are hiding for a reason.
> [color=crimson]Fugitives[/color] are actively wanted by the [color=cyan]TSFMC[/color], giving them [bold]150[/bold] [color=yellow]FMC[/color] if they manage to catch one.
> The [color=purple]Godfather[/color] has an even more lucrative bounty, with the TSFMC being offered [bold]400[/bold] [color=yellow]FMC[/color] for their capture.
Additionally, the [color=tan]Phaethon Dynasty's Sultanate[/color] is investigating these fugitives due to their status, and may end up marking them as [color=red][bold]heretics[/bold][/color] to be hunted down and assassinated by the [color=tan]PDV[/color].
[italic][color=gray](For this reason, the Heretic trait is ineligible to be chosen by Godfather/Fugitive, as they already have it by default.)[/color][/italic]
